subject.title: fix: resolve Codex fork duplication when parent is unresolved (#2108)

question: Should CodexBar replace the current fail-open missing-parent accounting policy with turn-ID-based cross-file suppression before copy-stable provenance is proven?
rationale: Current main intentionally prefers possible overcount over silently dropping legitimate child work when provenance is ambiguous, while this PR changes that user-visible accounting boundary.

options.title: Preserve fail-open policy
options.body: Require stronger provenance and live-corpus proof before suppressing missing-parent sibling rows across files.

options.title: Adopt turn-ID ownership
options.body: Accept turn IDs as sufficient provenance after all cache-transition defects and upgrade behavior are fixed and proven.

recommendation.title: Preserve fail-open policy
recommendation.body: Require stronger provenance and live-corpus proof before suppressing missing-parent sibling rows across files.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and current-main integrator, steipete is the best available owner for this user-visible accounting policy decision.
